caption: Prepared values typed into the remote app, each one read back from the pixels
Operator presses Pause: no further input. They correct a value by hand
Resume: fresh capture. The operator's value is kept, not overwritten
Intent written to the journal, then Save is clicked
The executor is killed before it reads the result
Restart: result unknown. Search, reopen, compare. Save is disabled
Verified on screen. No second Save
